description: The VCL counterpart of 18_button_keeps_its_place_when_text_grows. A button whose translated text outgrows it stays where it was drawn, even with a caption crowding it on the right and an empty margin beckoning on the left. Sliding a control into that margin is a treatment for a caption reaching towards the field it names; a button names nothing to its right, so moving it only detaches it from the layout it belongs to. Width is left out deliberately: how the button absorbs the longer text is a separate question from where it sits.
